videos.headline: Craig Overton to Siraj, out Caught by Bairstow! This is vengeful beyond England would have dared to imagine after the humiliation at Lords! Fittingly, it's Siraj who is pushed onto the backfoot by a seaming straightener, and gets a thick edge to Bairstow in the cordon to send England into delirium! He's not going to bother grabbing a stump this time, are you Mr. Siraj? It's India 1-1 England. Sweet English revenge. Siraj c Bairstow b Craig Overton 0(2)

Craig Overton to Jadeja, out Caught by Buttler!! Craig Overton with the ninth. A back of a length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, holds its line, Jadeja pokes away from the body and the thin edge is snaffled by Buttler. Again no need to review and just the formalities remain for England to level the series. Jadeja c Buttler b Craig Overton 30(25) [4s-5 6s-1]

Robinson to Ishant, out Caught by Buttler!! Five for Robinson. Thin nick and Robinson waves the ball to the crowd in celebration. Fullish outside off, holds its line, Ishant stretches forward to block and edges through to Buttler. Clear edge and Ishant doesn't even bother reviewing. Ishant c Buttler b Robinson 2(5)

Moeen Ali to Shami, out Bowled!! That's a ripper. Tossed up outside off, into the footmarks, spins sharply from there and beats Shami so comprehensively, that it makes him look like a novice with the bat. A gap so big between bat and pad, the ball crashes into off-stump and that's Shami done for the match with the bat. The end doesn't look too far away now. Shami b Moeen Ali 6(8) [4s-1]

Robinson to Pant, out Caught by Craig Overton!! Robinson takes off the aeroplane in celebration and has a few choice words at the departing Pant. There's no love lost between the English and Pant. They are giving it back to him now. Pant doesn't look comfortable on these shores. Is in a dilemma whether to attack or trust his defence. He goes while trying to do the latter, although it must be said that this is a poor shot. Bat well away from the body, pushing out and nicking it straight to third slip. The ball was on a length and angled across, again no need to play at that. Pant disappoints and India now in massive strife. Pant c Craig Overton b Robinson 1(7)

Anderson to Rahane, out Caught by Buttler!! Rahane goes and India in trouble now. Deserved wicket for Anderson. He leaps and roars in delight. A punch of the air with his right-fist to go with it. The wobbling seam delivery gets him the wicket. Angled in, around the imaginary 5th stump line, Rahane who has defended well so far, is sucked into feathering an edge through to Buttler. The pattern of his dismissals seems to continue with no change in his fortunes. Is it time to move on from India's vice-captain? That is for another day, but the silent whispers will get shriller by the minute. Rahane c Buttler b Anderson 10(25) [4s-2]

Robinson to Kohli, out Caught by Root!! Kohli is gone. Cannot cash in on his fifty. He shadow-practices the leave but it's too late. By then the Headingley crowd and the English contingent are on their feet celebrating. Does anyone want to guess how he got out? Same old story. Nicking off. Length ball outside off, straightening, didn't need to play at that, but since it was angled in, he went for the defence and edged it high to first slip's left. His opposite number takes it well and a distraught Kohli has to go. Head down and looking glum as he made his way back inside. After an over full of action, Robinson gets the big wicket. Kohli c Root b Robinson 55(125) [4s-8]

Robinson to Pujara, out Lbw!! No hundred for Pujara and Richard Kettleborough has to change the decision of his. Big celebrations from the English camp after seeing the replay on the big screen. A mental error from Pujara has cost him. This angled in fuller, towards off, Pujara planted his front pad forward and then offered no shot, the ball came in with the angle to rap him on the pad. HawkEye shows it to be hitting the off-stump which the umpire didn't think so. So a good review and India lose a wicket on day 4 without adding to their overnight score. Also ends Pujara's knock - probably his best away Test innings in a while. Looked fluent and more importantly didn't get into a rut. Pujara lbw b Robinson 91(189) [4s-15]

Robinson to Rohit, out Lbw!! Rohit is given LBW! India review! That looks dead as a dodo! Nothing on UltraEdge. Not good news for India. Impact in line, and that's clipping the top of leg-stump - umpire's call! Rohit has to go, and India's tryst with the umpire's call continues! He's fallen across an in-seamer, not for the first time today, and missed the flick. It looked a lot more plumb than it was, and the umpire raised the finger. Rohit smashes his bat into the ground in frustration. He's not happy - and he's paid dearly for playing across the line. India slide further, and it's this period either side of the break that's done it again. Rohit lbw b Robinson 59(156) [4s-7 6s-1]

Craig Overton to Rahul, out Caught by Bairstow!! Stunning catch and KL has to go. He shakes his head on the walk back. One-handed beauty from Bairstow at 2nd slip to his left and big smiles all around in the England camp. That will be lunch as well. Great ball and even better catch. Angled in, Rahul has to play as this is heading towards the off-stump and pad, takes the shoulder of the bat and flies to the right of first slip, but Bairstow dives, sticking his left-hand out and the ball glues into the palm. Deserved wicket for Craig Overton and England. Rahul c Bairstow b Craig Overton 8(54)

Shami to Craig Overton, out Lbw!! Shami has one more. Length delivery angling in, Craig Overton plants his front foot far too across, then tries to flick around that, always an issue when you are doing that, the ball misses the inside-edge and raps him near the kneeroll. Umpire Richard Kettleborough had no hesitation in raising the finger. Overton knew he was gone, but reviewed for formality sake. Craig Overton lbw b Shami 32(42) [4s-6]

Siraj to Sam Curran, out Caught by (sub)Mayank!! That's a mirror-image of Rohit Sharma's worst impulses! Short ball into the head, Sam Curran throws the kitchen sink at the hook and gets a bit of a top-edge, doesn't get all of that, and hands the most straightforward of catches to the substitute fielder, Mayank Agarwal! Sam Curran c (sub)Mayank b Siraj 15(30) [4s-2]

Jadeja to Moeen Ali, out Caught by (sub)Axar!! What's happening? There's been precious little for India to cheer about, but Moeen has failed to get under this flat ball, and tries lofting it over long-on, ends up handing a simple catch to Axar Patel at mid-on. It's a shot he plays extremely well, but unfortunately, this was perhaps a little too ambitious from him. Moeen Ali c (sub)Axar b Jadeja 8(18) [4s-1]

Bumrah to Root, out Bowled!! At long last! The Indians heave a sigh of relief, as they get rid of their chief tormentor - for now! That's seamed in and stayed lower than is true, and Root regrets coming across in his trigger as this sneaks through between bat and pad to crash into off-stump! A big "Roooooooooot" echoes across the stadium, as he leaves the field and he raises his bat to acknowledge the applause and appreciation. Yet another terrific innings comes to an end - his third hundred of the tour. Root b Bumrah 121(165) [4s-14]

Shami to Buttler, out Caught by Ishant!! Gone! Kohli was seen shaking his head after the previous ball. Now, he's pumped up. A soft dismissal. Fullish ball on the pads, should have been put away. Buttler clips but doesn't get the placement right. Hits it straight to Ishant at square leg. Buttler c Ishant b Shami 7(12) [4s-1]

Shami to Bairstow, out Caught by Kohli!! The bowling change has worked! Shami returns and strikes. Removes the dangerous Bairstow. 136kph, seam-up ball, angles in on a good length and straightens ever so lightly. Bairstow pushes hard at it and gets an outside nick. Kohli, at first slip, takes a fine, low catch. Even the keeper was diving across to his right but that didn't distract the Indian captain. Bairstow c Kohli b Shami 29(43) [4s-4 6s-1]

Siraj to Malan, out Caught by Pant!! Malan grimaces as he sees the UltraEdge pop up a spike on the big screen. Knows he's done for the innings. Meanwhile Kohli with a big smile ruffles Siraj's hair as the players head for tea. Harmless full delivery down leg, Malan flicks and the bat is well away from the pad, so the only thing it could've touched was the bat as it went past. Looked innocuous to everyone, until Siraj appealed and almost forced Kohli to refer. And it turned out to be a masterstroke in the end. Malan c Pant b Siraj 70(128) [4s-11]

Jadeja to Haseeb Hameed, out Bowled!! Knocked him over! Jadeja has pulled a drowning India out of the water for a millisecond, and this is temporary relief for India! He's angled this in, and gotten it to straighten, Haseeb Hameed gets forward for the familiar forward defence, and that's a beauty that spins past the outside edge to hit the top of off-stump! First wicket of the series for Jadeja, and one that's come at a desperate time for India. Hameed departs for a well-made 68, but India still have a long way to go to break even after the horror show yesterday. Haseeb Hameed b Jadeja 68(195) [4s-12]

Shami to Rory Burns, out Bowled!! Finally, India have something to celebrate! 133kph, in-angling seam-up ball from round the wicket, further nips back in off the surface. Burns moves across a bit to defend and doesn't account for the inward movement. The ball sneaks through the bat-pad gap to hit the top of off. Rory Burns b Shami 61(153) [4s-6 6s-1]

Craig Overton to Shami, out Caught by Rory Burns!! Fifty in the previous innings, a golden duck for Shami this time! It's unravelling too quickly on this opening day for India. Back of a length outside off, shapes away, Shami has a poke and the edge goes to gully. Burns snaffles it. Shami c Rory Burns b Craig Overton 0(1)

Robinson to Pant, out Caught by Buttler!! Oh that's a sloppy shot. Very loose. Short of length outside off, Pant goes chasing looking to punch it through the off-side ring. The ball keeps going across with the angle from over the wicket. And further contributes to what's been the theme of the day - an outside edge to Buttler. Pant c Buttler b Robinson 2(9)

Robinson to Rahane, out Caught by Buttler!! Edged and gone! Rahane departs at the stroke of lunch. Good length ball straightens ever so slightly around the fifth stump zone and Rahane has a poke at it. No feet movement and sticks his bat out against a ball he could have left alone. Ends up getting a faint outside nick that's been gobbled up by the keeper. Robinson's elated and Rahane is distraught. And, it's lunch on day one... Rahane c Buttler b Robinson 18(54) [4s-3]

Anderson to Kohli, out Caught by Buttler!! There it is! Not often does one see a moment with an air of finality in the first session of a Test! Look at Buttler throw it up in the air - resembling Stokes back-arching celebration here, 2 years ago! Anderson, nearly 40 years of age, screams and sprints faster than he did during his run-up! It's the big fish. It's the whale. The uncertainty of the wobble-seam does the trick, as this lands on a length and jags away ever so slightly. Kohli's unleashed a confident checked cover drive, but it's taken a thick outside edge through to the wicketkeeper who grabs it and launches it into orbit in celebration. What a difference a session can make. 65 balls, and the whole country believes in its team again. Kohli c Buttler b Anderson 7(17) [4s-1]

Anderson to Pujara, out Caught by Buttler!! Pujara's horror run continues! He's let Pujara brood over the inswingers for an over, he's crawled into his brain, and then once that set, he's served up the outswinger first up to get Pujara poking uncharacteristically outside off, and that's a thick edge through to Buttler. India in huge trouble! Pujara c Buttler b Anderson 1(9)

Anderson to Rahul, out Caught by Buttler!! What has he done? After that masterclass at Lord's, KL Rahul has thrown it away at Leeds! It really is a fickle, harsh art, batting in England. Anderson throws the bait a little wide, gets a pitched up ball to nip off the seam, Rahul chases after it to crash it through the covers, and gets a healthy edge through to Buttler who gobbles it up. A terrific start for England. Destiny you lazy fox, write a new script! Rahul c Buttler b Anderson 0(4)
